checks: For every row, checked profile domain/order, vertex-count formula, alpha, first negative zero-extended difference, eligibility, selector from recorded leaf-deletion differences, selected-tag/term correspondence, exact sum, and sign.

independent_factor_recalculation.method: Recomputed P and every original leaf deletion selector/summand using explicit branch factors B_r=(1+z)^r+z and closed-form deletion polynomials; no tree traversal or producer DP used.
